value.title: Mini - Episode 11
value.synopsis: Vooren Glanz, Wilibald Koenig, Rhiner Neumann and Matheus Johan Weiss are in a room while Neumann and Koenig complained to Weiss about his drunk attitude that scares women away, this caused them being not popular around women. Weiss will sexually harass women with words while he is drunk, which he claims it as only being compliments.Upon hearing this fact, the three was shocked especially Vooren. Weiss promised that he will not make the mistake again, then they went to get drinks.Unfortunately, Weiss got drunk and sexually harassed women. The other three stood aside, talking how they view alcohol as a prohibited item for Weiss then on. Suddenly, Viktoriya Ivanovna Serebryakov appeared being uncomfortable with two men harassing her. The four helped Visha and drove the men away. Visha being grateful to them as she does not know that Weiss harassed women sexually when he is drunk.
